_meta: Manual analysis of open/videos from contact sheets and zoomed frames. conf: A = visible difference vs a matched control and the norm fits; B = event fits the norm but no clean control; C = label not explained. Rules refer to rules_kb.json ids.

1.seen: Client sits across; cashier counts banknotes by hand; client reaches toward the money at ~23.5 s. Manual counting is normal (control X-3 does it too).

2.seen: Client enters, puts a note on the desk at ~8.5-10 s; later cashier reaches across the desk with cash.

4.seen: Client leaves at ~55 s with banknotes lying on the desk, returns at 57 s; cashier stays seated.

11.seen: Cashier walks away from the desk; laptop still shows the work screen. Room lights switch off.

13.seen: Cash lies on the desk (40-44 s) while cashier stands at the open safe, moving cash by hand between desk and safe.

15.seen: Green cash bag stays on the desk while the cashier walks out of the room.

17.seen: Man in dark jacket brings a green bag in, puts it on the desk, cashier takes it, he leaves. Candidate rules (unverified): collector crew/kit, bag checks.

18.seen: A second visitor (white shirt) enters while the first is still at the desk and hands something over.

20.seen: Cashier at the safe, then sits. Almost identical to control X-21.

22.seen: Cashier closes the safe and leaves; laptop already on the lock screen at 10 s; safe door was open while she sat (6.5-9.5 s).

24.seen: Cashier goes to the safe and leaves; tablet and cans stay on the desk; safe closed.

26.seen: Cashier leaves; a banknote stays on the desk until the end. Control X-27 has an empty desk.

28.seen: Cashier stands up and leaves with the laptop still on the work screen. Control X-29 locks the screen first.

30.seen: Man in dark jacket walks behind the desk and stands next to the cashier at the counting machine.

32.seen: Workplace empty from 0 s; cashier enters through the door at ~5 s.

33.seen: Workplace empty; cashier enters at 4.5-6 s; a man walks by behind the glass at 10.5 s.

34.seen: Visitor in white leaves the room, cashier reaches toward the counting machine.

38.seen: First client gone by ~16 s; two small banknote packs still on the desk when a new visitor enters at 31.5-33 s.

40.seen: Cashier puts a beige coat and a patterned handbag on the cash desk and works beside them.

44.seen: Cashier counts banknotes by hand alone at the desk; small object in her left hand at 13 s. Possible: counting without a controlling employee.

46.seen: Cashier picks up a cup and drinks at the desk; food on the desk.

47.seen: Long clip; client and cashier exchange cash; moment unclear.

controls_inspected.3: Man enters, sits, hands money, cashier counts by hand; leaves. Normal transaction.
controls_inspected.21: Cashier takes cash from the safe and sits at the desk; same motion as violating X-20.
controls_inspected.23: Cashier locks the laptop, goes to the safe, leaves the room.
controls_inspected.25: Cashier goes to the safe and leaves; desk has no cash.
controls_inspected.27: Cashier goes to the safe and leaves; desk empty (pair of X-26).
controls_inspected.29: Cashier locks the laptop (Windows lock screen), goes to the safe, leaves (pair of X-28).
